subject: Animation
title: Syndrome: The Fan Turned Enemy
description: One-minute skill: Syndrome: The Fan Turned Enemy.

hook.text: Syndrome from The Incredibles was Mr. Incredible's biggest fan as a child — until his hero rejected him.

buildup.text: Rejected and humiliated, he used his genius to build technology that could destroy real superheroes.

discovery.text: Syndrome's plan — making everyone super so no one is — is a twisted philosophy about equality and resentment.

twist.text: Syndrome has no powers. He is a normal person who out-engineers superheroes — making him terrifyingly relatable.

climax.text: Syndrome showed that the most dangerous villain is one who was once an ally driven away by carelessness.

punchline.text: The scariest villain is a rejected fan with enough brains to get revenge.

quiz.question: What is Syndrome's core motivation in The Incredibles?
options: He wants to gain superpowers for himself
He was rejected by his hero as a child and built technology to destroy superheroes out of resentment
He wants to take over the world for financial gain
